The '''Wartaki Islands''' were a group of islands located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]].<ref name="BMF 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Wartaki Islands were introduced in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 43" /> which was published around [[October 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|43}}</ref> The [[Wartaki Islands/Legends|islands]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where they were first mentioned in [[A. C. Crispin]]'s [[1998]] novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]''.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
